source_refs.note: Exercise 4.3, Question 8: book page 77 (PDF 82); answer key PDF 303

blocks.prompt: 8 The point \(A\) is mapped to \((30, 20, -5)\) by the scaling matrix \(P = \begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}\). Find the coordinates of \(A\). [Hint: If \(A\) is mapped to \(A'\) by scaling matrix \(P\), then \(AP = A'\)]
blocks.explanation:
Yeh scaling ka ulta sawal hai: image (naya point) maloom hai, asal point nahi.
Humein \(A\) nikalna hai.
Plan: \(A\) ko row \([a\ b\ c]\) likhein, \(AP = A'\) banayein, entries compare karein, phir tasdeeq.
Dhyan dein: hint mein \(AP = A'\) likha hai, yani yahan point ko row matrix likhna hai, column nahi. Agar column bhi likhein to diagonal matrix ki wajah se jawab wohi aata hai, lekin hamesha hint ke mutabiq chalein. Scaling matrix har coordinate ko ek hi number (yahan \(-5\)) se zarb karta hai, is liye ulta kaam yeh hai ke har coordinate ko \(-5\) se divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: scaling matrix \(P = \begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix}\) point \(A\) ko \(A' = (30, 20, -5)\) par le jata hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(A\) ke coordinates.
Tareeqa: Hint ke mutabiq \(AP = A'\), jahan \(A = [a\ \ b\ \ c]\) row matrix hai. Zarb kar ke dono taraf ke entries compare karenge.

\(AP = A'\) likhein
\[[a\ \ b\ \ c]\begin{bmatrix}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -5\end{bmatrix} = [30\ \ 20\ \ -5]\]
Kyun: \(1 \times 3\) row matrix ko \(3 \times 3\) matrix se zarb karein to \(1 \times 3\) row hi banti hai, jo \(A'\) ki shakal hai. Is liye yahan \(A\) ko row likha hai, column nahi.

Row ko har column se zarb karein
\[[-5a + 0 + 0\ \ \ 0 - 5b + 0\ \ \ 0 + 0 - 5c]\]
\[= [-5a\ \ -5b\ \ -5c]\]
Kyun: Har entry \([a\ b\ c]\) aur \(P\) ke ek column ka zarb hai. \(P\) diagonal matrix hai, is liye baqi terms zero ho jate hain aur har coordinate bas \(-5\) se zarb hota hai. Scaling ka yahi matlab hai.

Entries compare karein
\[-5a = 30 \Rightarrow a = -6\]
\[-5b = 20 \Rightarrow b = -4\]
\[-5c = -5 \Rightarrow c = 1\]
Kyun: Do matrices barabar hon to un ke mutabiq (corresponding) entries barabar hote hain. Har equation ko \(-5\) se divide kiya; negative ko negative se divide karne par positive aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[[-6\ \ -4\ \ 1]P = [30\ \ 20\ \ -5] \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((-5)(-6) = 30\), \((-5)(-4) = 20\), \((-5)(1) = -5\): wapas \(A'\) mil gaya. Doosra tareeqa: \(A = A'P^{-1}\) aur \(P^{-1} = -\frac{1}{5}I_3\), yani har coordinate ko \(-5\) se divide karna; jawab wohi aata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key "8. \(A'(-6, -4, 1)\)" chhapti hai. Sawal \(A\) maang raha hai; \(A'\) to diya hua image \((30, 20, -5)\) hai. Point \((-6, -4, 1)\) asal mein \(A\) hai, \(A'\) nahi.
